St Stephen’s Catholic Primary School will be holding three open meetings for parents/carers of children due to start school in September 2027:
Friday 6th November at 9.30am and 1.15pm

There will be a talk from the Headteacher and the opportunity to tour the school.
Booking is not required, please attend on your chosen session.
